name: Punch
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: a quart of rum or of the best whiskey
ingredients.originalText: a quart of rum or of the best whiskey
ingredients.quantityText: a quart of rum or of the best whiskey

instructions.text: Roll lemons under your hand on the table
Pare off the yellow rind very thin
Boil the rind in a gallon of water till all the flavour is drawn out
Break up into a large bowl two pounds of loaf-sugar, and squeeze the lemons over it
When the water has boiled sufficiently, strain it from the lemon-peel
Mix it with the lemon juice and sugar
Stir in a quart of rum or of the best whiskey

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Roll lemons under your hand on the table
2. Pare off the yellow rind very thin
3. Boil the rind in a gallon of water till all the flavour is drawn out
4. Break up into a large bowl two pounds of loaf-sugar, and squeeze the lemons over it
5. When the water has boiled sufficiently, strain it from the lemon-peel
6. Mix it with the lemon juice and sugar
7. Stir in a quart of rum or of the best whiskey
